snippet.title: Session: Skate Sim - Prague DLC Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
Dobrý den,

Prepare to skate through the iconic streets of Prague with our latest DLC for Session: Skate Sim! Explore the city in a whole new way.

Master your tricks at renowned spots and uncover hidden gems along the way. Jump into the vibrant Prague skate scene today!

Available now on PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5.

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games #sessionskatesim
